critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: FinanceModule.jsx - canEdit variable was defined in parent component scope but referenced in InvoicesTab and PaymentsTab sub-functions without access. Added canEdit calculation inside each sub-function using the user prop they receive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 9 features verified working: (1) CEO sees 'Subjects & Classes' tab when viewing teacher profiles - can check/uncheck subjects and year groups, (2) Logo watermark at 4% opacity on DashboardLayout.jsx, (3) Success tick animation via SuccessTick.jsx and successToast() helper, (4) Finance module role-based access - Admin has read-only (can view but not create), Finance/SuperAdmin/CEO have full access. Bug was found and fixed in FinanceModule.jsx regarding canEdit variable scope in sub-components.

bug_fixed.issue: canEdit variable was defined at parent component level but InvoicesTab and PaymentsTab functions couldn't access it due to JavaScript function scope
bug_fixed.fix: Added 'const canEdit = ["SuperAdmin", "FinanceOfficer", "CEO"].includes(user?.role);' inside both InvoicesTab (line 196) and PaymentsTab (line 281) functions
